🚀 Project Description: Wunder Challenge LOB Predictorium (OFI-Alpha & Strict Packaging)

1. Project Objective 🎯
Develop a high-precision forecasting system to predict dual future price-movement targets (t0, t1) using Limit Order Book (LOB) sequences. The success metric is a Weighted Pearson Correlation >= 0.34.

2. Data & Alpha Engineering 📈
Input: Parquet sequences of 1000 timesteps with 32 features. 
CRITICAL ALPHA: Raw LOB data is non-stationary. The data loader MUST convert raw bid/ask volumes into Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) features and normalize all price levels relative to the mid-price. Output shape must remain strictly (batch, 1000, 32). Respect warm-up logic (steps 0-98) and predict only for steps 99-999.

3. Architecture: Temporal Fusion DeepLOB 🧠
Spatial Feature Extraction: CNN layers (DeepLOB style) to extract spatial relationships.
Temporal/Sequence: Utilize LSTM networks or Temporal Self-Attention, as sequence modeling is mathematically proven to outperform standard MLPs on LOB data.

4. Loss Function: Direct Correlation 🎯
Do NOT use MSE. Implement a custom Weighted Pearson Loss function that directly maximizes correlation. Apply amplitude weighting (w_i = |y_i|) as per competition rules. Enforce output clipping to the [-6, 6] range.

5. Strict Deployment & Packaging Constraints 📦
Docker Pathing Fix: The inference script (solution.py) MUST load the ONNX model using a strict relative path: `onnx_path = 'model.onnx'` (no os.path.dirname logic).
Prerun Test: The pipeline must include a local `prerun.py` script that instantiates PredictionModel and tests a dummy (1, 1000, 32) array.
Final Deliverable: The packaging script MUST create a flat `submission.zip` containing EXACTLY three files: solution.py, model.onnx, and utils.py. Actual solution.py and utils.py in root. solution.py should have wundern simplest path to model.onnx. No subdirectories or extra files are allowed.

backlog.title: Implement Data Loader with OFI Feature Engineering and Normalization
backlog.why: To preprocess raw LOB data into stationary OFI features and normalize relative to mid-price, ensuring correct input shape for the model as per competition requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Data loader reads parquet sequences and outputs tensors with shape (batch, 1000, 32)
Implements Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) calculation for bid/ask volumes
Normalizes all price levels relative to the mid-price
Respects warm-up logic by handling steps 0-98 appropriately during data preparation

backlog.title: Build CNN-LSTM Hybrid Model for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
backlog.why: To extract spatial features with CNN and model temporal dependencies with LSTM, adhering to the Temporal Fusion DeepLOB architecture for accurate predictions.
acceptance_criteria: Model defined with CNN layers for spatial feature extraction
LSTM layers integrated for sequence modeling
Output layer predicts dual targets (t0, t1) for steps 99-999
Model can be instantiated and forward pass works with input shape (batch, 1000, 32)

backlog.title: Develop Custom Weighted Pearson Loss with Amplitude Weighting and Clipping
backlog.why: To directly maximize correlation as per competition metric, with output clipping to [-6,6] for stable training.
acceptance_criteria: Loss function implements Weighted Pearson formula with amplitude weighting w_i = |y_i|
Includes output clipping to range [-6, 6] before loss calculation
Unit tests cover at least 5 scenarios including edge cases like zero weights or extreme values

backlog.title: Set Up Training Loop with Configuration and Hyperparameters
backlog.why: To train the model using specified batch size, epochs, and learning rate, integrating all components for end-to-end training.
acceptance_criteria: Training script uses batch size 32, epochs 100, learning rate 0.001 as per preset
Integrates data loader, model, and custom loss function
Includes validation loop and tracks training metrics

backlog.title: Implement Weighted Pearson Correlation Evaluation Metric
backlog.why: To compute the competition metric for model evaluation, ensuring alignment with success criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Function to calculate weighted Pearson correlation matching competition formula
Metric can be computed on predictions and ground truth during evaluation

backlog.title: Create ONNX Export and Inference Script with Strict Pathing
backlog.why: To prepare the model for deployment in competition environment, ensuring solution.py loads model.onnx with correct relative path.
acceptance_criteria: Export trained model to ONNX format using PyTorch's export functionality
solution.py implements PredictionModel interface and loads model.onnx with strict relative path 'model.onnx'
Inference function handles input shape (1, 1000, 32) and outputs predictions for steps 99-999

backlog.title: Implement Prerun Test and Final Submission Packaging
backlog.why: To validate the pipeline locally and create submission.zip with exactly three files as per strict deployment constraints.
acceptance_criteria: prerun.py script instantiates PredictionModel and tests with dummy (1, 1000, 32) array without errors
Packaging script creates submission.zip containing only solution.py, model.onnx, and utils.py in root directory
All paths in solution.py use strict relative path 'model.onnx' without os.path.dirname logic

prd_backlog.execution_plan: FOR EACH item: Implement -> Verify -> Commit.
definition_of_done: Weighted Pearson Correlation metric reaches or exceeds 0.35 on validation set
